rows.label: bf03020100_0030
rows.name:
Was the awakening of Heaven's Holy Grail
a miscalculation?

rows.label: bf03020100_0040
rows.name:
Well, it was written in my script
from the very beginning.

rows.label: bf03020100_0050
rows.name:
Sure, you say that once it's
all over and done with.

rows.label: bf03020100_0060
rows.name:
Honestly, Yoshitsune, you're
sounding pretty small-time.

rows.label: bf03020100_0105
rows.name:
And my beloved younger sister
is out hunting, as always.

rows.label: bf03020100_0110
rows.name:
I'm sure plenty of Drivers
are falling prey to her again.

rows.label: bf03020100_0130
rows.name:
It's not as if simply collecting
Core Crystals is enough.

rows.label: bf03020100_0140
rows.name:
Do you know the Holy
Grail's current location?

rows.label: bf03020100_0150
rows.name: Who do you think you're asking?

rows.label: bf03020100_0180
rows.name:
Hm! It seems they're currently traveling
away from the urban area of Gula.

rows.label: bf03020100_0190
rows.name:
Leaving the town? But there's
nothing out that way...

rows.label: bf03020100_0200
rows.name:
Perhaps they're on their
way out of Gula itself.

rows.label: bf03020100_0220
rows.name:
Looks like that regular transport
has set sail.

rows.label: bf03020100_0230
rows.name:
Core Crystal baptisms at the Holy See, huh?
How dutiful of them.

rows.label: bf03020100_0240
rows.name: Shall we deal with them first?

rows.label: bf03020100_0250
rows.name:
I'll handle that. You all
pursue the Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf03020100_0270
rows.name:
I've been wanting to see Heaven's Holy Grail
with my own eyes.

rows.label: bf03020100_0286
rows.name:
Judging by the wavelength,
I think it's Byakko's.

rows.label: bf03020100_0288
rows.name:
Looks like they're traveling
with Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf03020100_0300
rows.name: I see... Then I'll take you up on that.

rows.label: bf03020100_0310
rows.name: We'll keep using the Monoceros, then.
